sloka: तत्र एकाम् रजनीम् व्युष्य प्रभाते राम गम्यताम् ।दक्षिणाम् दिशम् आस्थाय वन षण्डस्य पार्श्वतः ॥३-११-४०॥
transliteration: tatra ekām rajanīm vyuṣya prabhāte rāma gamyatām ।dakṣiṇām diśam āsthāya vana ṣaṇḍasya pārśvataḥ ॥3-11-40॥

translations.english: O Rama, there are lotusponds filled with clear, sacred waters, with different kinds of swans, ducks and ruddy geese. Spend one night there and proceed early in the morning.
